## SUPPORT Study

SUPPORT (Study to Understand Prognoses and Preferences for Outcomes and Risks of Treatments) is a prospective study of 9,105 hospitalized adults from 5 hospitals:

Phase I: A 2-year observational cohort (n = 4,301) 
Phase II: A 2-year controlled trial of a nurse-facilitated communication intervention (n = 4,804, randomized by physician group to intervention or control). 

Patients were selected by 1 or more of 8 diagnosis categories (9 originally): acute respiratory failure (ARF)/multiorgan system failure (MOSF) with sepsis, MOSF with malignancy, COPD, CHF, cirrhosis, nontraumatic coma, metastatic colon cancer, and non-small cell lung cancer — plus severity-of-illness criteria (overall 6-month mortality of 47%).

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(tidyverse)
library(gtsummary)
library(pROC)

tmp <- tempfile()
download.file("https://hbiostat.org/data/repo/support2csv.zip", tmp)
sup <- read.csv(unz(tmp, "support2.csv"))
```
